change: Limit ordinary TabOpen/TabClose refreshes to an agreed normal-tab Space; retain global fallback for all uncertain or wider structural changes.
unchanged: All class bytes from #refreshTimer onward match the base, including debounce, closed idle scheduling, flush, rendering, folder editor and drag handling.

headless.sourceTransformation: Only custom-element tag and section render registration differ from each production source; baseline and candidate use the same transformation and fixture.
fallbacks: real cross-Space move followed by ordinary open
ordinary closes from two Spaces coalesce
lifecycleChecks: folder editor focus/draft/selection and existing row preservation
all original owned tabs retained and temporary tabs removed

packagedMode: --mode packaged --variant candidate --app <owned app> --manifest <receipt> --manifest-sha256 <pinned receipt SHA256>; runtime module bytes must match this source, no source injection. Accepts schema1 owned-diagnostic-derivative or schema2 owned-resource-derivative with signature/updater and unchanged engine/native/assets flags.

retainedFailure.cause: Fixture created the folder in the default active Space, so its supposed other-Space tab was correctly deferred while editing. Added explicit workspaceId to the test fixture; product code unchanged.

limitations: Headless correctness and deterministic work counts, not elapsed-time, benchmark-score or native appearance evidence.
The unknown assignment notification is synthetic on a real owned tab; grouping, cross-Space move, shared Essential close and ordinary tab events use real browser operations.
The root-owned combined packaged candidate still needs its separate no-injection check.
